introducer_furl.description: The FURL (encrypted URL) of the introducer server to join. Leave empty to operate as a standalone node (no sharing).

webapi.description: Web API settings for management via HTTP.

listen.description: Network endpoint for the web API (e.g., tcp:12345 or tcp:0.0.0.0:12345).

auth_token.description: Secret token for authenticating API requests. Set a strong random value in production.

enabled.description: Enable SFTP server for secure file access via SFTP protocol.

fuse.description: FUSE filesystem mount settings (for POSIX-like access).

enabled.description: Enable FUSE mount — not recommended for production servers.

mount.description: Local directory to mount the FUSE filesystem (e.g., /mnt/tahoe).

readonly.description: Allow anonymous users to read public shares. Write access is never allowed for anonymous users.

node.description: Core node identity and network behavior.

nickname.description: Human-readable name for this node (used in introducer reports and UIs).

privkey_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the node’s private key file.

pubkey_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the node’s public key file.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up on a connection to another node.

connection_attempts.description: Maximum connection attempts per remote node before giving up.

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous network connections this node will open.

autostart.description: Start all services (storage, introducer, etc.) automatically on node launch.

storage.description: Storage server configuration. Enables this node to store encrypted data shares.

enabled.description: Enable storage of encrypted data shares on this node.

storage_dir.description: Directory where encrypted data shares are stored (must be writable by the Tahoe user).

reserved_space.description: Bytes to keep free on the filesystem (e.g., for OS logs and temp space).

max_shares.description: Maximum number of shares to store on this node (0 = unlimited).

min_shares.description: Minimum number of shares (k) required to reconstruct a file (set by client).

num_shares.description: Total number of shares (n) created for each file (set by client); n >= k.

desired_replication.description: How many storage servers should hold each share (set by client).

preferred_share_size.description: Target size (bytes) for each share — used for performance tuning (not a strict limit).

max_share_size.description: Hard limit (in bytes) on share size (0 = unlimited).

anonymous_storage.description: Accept shares from anyone without authentication (not recommended unless intentionally open).

client_quotas.description: List of per-client storage quotas (by client ID).

storage_server_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for storage operations (read/write) before timing out.

destination.description: Log destination: 'stdout', 'stderr', or path to log file.

timestamp.description: Include ISO timestamps in log entries.

additional_introducers.description: List of additional introducer FURLs (beyond the main one). Each adds redundancy for node discovery.
